candidates.acceptance_criterion: Treatment net_profit_factor > baseline AND treatment net_return > baseline AND cost_drag increase not solely explaining any gross improvement; exit divergence still observed.
candidates.baseline_vs_treatment: Baseline: current MV2 exits without midband gate. Treatment: V6 composite midband/max-hold gate PLUS post-forced-exit re-entry cooldown.
candidates.causal_rationale: V6 shows +457 short trades via earlier forced exits then re-entry; T-only trades net negative with large cost drag while gross improves insufficiently.
candidates.expected_trade_count_turnover_effect: Material reduction vs V6 treatment turnover (toward baseline), lower fee/slippage drag; not parameter retune of midband formula.
candidates.not_mere_v6_parameter_tuning: Adds a distinct post-exit eligibility/cooldown mechanism absent from V6; does not retune midband threshold or max-hold=48.
candidates.rejection_criterion: NET_PROFIT_FACTOR_NOT_IMPROVED OR improvement solely from trade-count collapse OR no exit divergence OR cooldown alters entries before first forced exit.
candidates.treatment_boundary: After a forced midband (or composite) exit, suppress same-instrument re-entry for a frozen cooldown horizon; baseline remains V6 control without cooldown; max-hold semantics unchanged.

candidates.acceptance_criterion: Treatment net_profit_factor > baseline AND mean_mfe_to_exit_leakage treatment < control AND net_return treatment > control.
candidates.baseline_vs_treatment: Baseline: no midband gate. Treatment: midband gate armed only under open-PnL/capture condition; max-hold may remain independent.
candidates.causal_rationale: Shared-entry end_of_data→signal truncations destroyed large baseline winners (net delta ~-4754) while stop_loss→signal rescues helped; conditioning preserves loss-cutting and reduces premature winner cuts.
candidates.expected_trade_count_turnover_effect: Fewer forced exits than V6; turnover between baseline and V6; less winner truncation.
candidates.not_mere_v6_parameter_tuning: Changes exit semantics from unconditional forced midband to state-conditioned eligibility; not a numeric retune of band lookback/width.
candidates.rejection_criterion: NET_PROFIT_FACTOR_NOT_IMPROVED OR condition never fires (no divergence) OR condition equivalent to unconditional V6 midband on this sample by construction only if preregistered identically (forbidden).
candidates.treatment_boundary: Force midband exit only when open-position net PnL (or frozen capture-ratio) meets a preregistered non-negative/threshold condition; otherwise defer to stop-loss/max-hold/natural exit.

candidates.acceptance_criterion: Treatment net_profit_factor > baseline with observed midband-eligibility events AND exits_forced_by_unconditional_override == 0 by design.
candidates.baseline_vs_treatment: Baseline: no midband gate. Treatment: midband cross enables exit but does not override a hold/entry raw signal into forced flat.
candidates.causal_rationale: V6 earliest causal boundary is unconditional forced exit overriding raw signal; ledger maps many forced events to signal exits and then re-entry. Soft eligibility tests whether force itself is the harmful step.
candidates.expected_trade_count_turnover_effect: Likely near-baseline trade counts if override was the sole driver of fragmentation; falsifiable against V6 churn signature.
candidates.not_mere_v6_parameter_tuning: Changes control-flow authority of the gate (eligibility vs force), not midband formula parameters.
candidates.rejection_criterion: No behavioral divergence from baseline OR NET_PROFIT_FACTOR_NOT_IMPROVED OR hidden force-flat equivalence to V6.
candidates.treatment_boundary: Treat midband cross as exit-eligibility / soft-exit permission that may flatten only when engine/signal already favors exit, rather than unconditionally forcing flat against raw signal.

note: Candidates are falsifiable proposals only; not preregistered; not authorized for V7 execution.
